query: MATCH (edition:Spec)<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(s:Section) WHERE edition.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH edition,count(DISTINCT s) AS secCnt OPTIONAL MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec), (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release) WHERE hub.specNumber=edition.specNumber AND rel.releaseName=edition.specRelease WITH edition,secCnt,count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCnt RETURN edition.id AS editionId,edition.specNumber AS specNumber,edition.specRelease AS release,crCnt AS crCount,secCnt AS sectionCount,toFloat(crCnt)/secCnt AS density
